title: Cisco Certified DevNet Associate
overview: The Cisco Certified DevNet Associate (DevNet Associate) course is designed to provide foundational knowledge and skills in software development and automation using Cisco technologies. It covers network programmability, APIs, and automation concepts, focusing on how to integrate and automate network functions using Cisco's development tools and platforms.
audience: Network engineers and developers interested in network automation.
IT professionals involved in network programmability and API integrations.
Individuals seeking to enhance their skills in Cisco's development and automation technologies.
Students and learners aiming for certification in network automation and programmability.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of Cisco DevNet concepts and technologies.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for developing and automating network solutions using Cisco tools.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to apply development and automation skills.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore network programmability challenges and best practices.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a foundational understanding of network programmability and automation with Cisco technologies.
To develop practical skills in using Cisco's APIs, SDKs, and development tools.
To prepare participants for the Cisco Certified DevNet Associate (DevNet Associate) certification exam.
To equip participants with knowledge to design, develop, and implement network automation solutions.
